surface_mechanism_description: The surface reaction mechanism involves the formation of MoS2 through atomic layer deposition (ALD) using Mo(CO)6 and H2S plasma as precursors. Post-sulfurization at high temperatures is conducted to form stoichiometric MoS2 and enhance crystallinity. The surface reactions are influenced by the ALD cycles and post-sulfurization parameters, which affect the surface stoichiometry and microstructures.
